name: session-report
description: Generate an explorable HTML report of Codex session usage — tokens, subagents, slash commands, expensive turns.

interface.shortDescription: HTML usage report for Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Scans ~/.codex/sessions transcripts and generates a self-contained HTML report with token totals, project breakdown, session timeline, subagent costs, and optimization recommendations.
defaultPrompt: Generate a session report for the last 7 days.
Show me my token usage this week.
Session report for the last 30 days.
